lines.text: I go on last, after the drawings and the sentence. Headliners always do.
Some people trust only their porch thermometer. It's been in direct sun since 1994.
Checking three apps and believing the nicest isn't forecasting. It's voting.
I'm a paper doll with internet. Somehow that makes me a smart device.
It says 'Fri' up there. For most people, that's the whole forecast.
